name: Organizations
description: People joined in a collective trade, pursuit, or goal

results.name: Bloody Skulls
results.description: Bands of scavenging shipbreakers who lie in wait along hazardous passages. They believe that painting their faces with a death-like visage protect against retribution by spirits of the dead.

results.name: Cynosure League
results.description: Guild of scientists and naturalists who record their findings in exhaustively-detailed journals. Their works are copied and recorded by archivists at a grand central library.

results.name: Ebb Tide
results.description: Covert insurgency of spies and saboteurs. They seek to cripple imperial ambitions from within, and use trained gulls to carry vital messages to collaborators.

results.name: Faceless Accord
results.description: Renegades sailing in defiance of imperial powers. They conceal their identities behind iron masks to protect kinfolk still under imperial rule.

results.name: Forsaken Fleet
results.description: Powerful clan of pirates led by a marauder known as the Raven Queen. They recently sacked and seized a major port town and made it a refuge for outlaws and outcasts.

results.name: Ironmongers
results.description: Guild of shipbuilders and arms manufacturers who supply their destructive wares to the highest bidder. They secretly incite wars to expand their fortune.

results.name: Moonsingers
results.description: Mystic coven that draw their powers from the dance of the moons and the rhythm of the tides. They recruit and train talented initiates from across the isles.

results.name: Saltblood
results.description: Mariners bound to an age-old seafaring fellowship. They recognize fellow saltbloods and communicate using complex hand signals.

results.name: Tide Runners
results.description: Smugglers who ferry their ill-gotten goods from island to island. They rely on speed, stealth, and the cover of foul weather or moonless nights.

results.name: Wayfarers
results.description: Peddlers who range across the isles and beyond. They transport rare and unusual cargo aboard their vibrantly painted ships.
